functions.name: note.backlinks
functions.description: Lists the rows that point at the row, across every table, through a reference or a ref block of a message, each one the caller can read, most recent first. Only the owner of a row whose audience is not everyone hears how many rows it cannot see point at it.

id.description: The key of the Note row the operation runs on.

functions.name: note.attachments
functions.description: Lists the row's ready files, oldest first.

id.description: The key of the Note row the operation runs on.

functions.name: note.references
functions.description: Lists the references the row holds, oldest first, each to a row the caller can read.

id.description: The key of the Note row the operation runs on.

functions.name: note.addReference
functions.description: Makes the row point at another row, of any table it may point at, with a role (none unless given), once per target and role; answers the reference, the one there when it was there.

id.description: The key of the Note row the operation runs on.

role.description: The reference's role: none unless given. A remove with none removes the references of every role.

to.description: The row the reference points at.

key.description: The row's key in its wire form.

table.description: The row's table, by its type's name (Issue).
